properties.verseOrder: v1 v2 v3 v4 v5 v6 v7

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Abakooye-ennyo.
Yesu bwe yagamba bw'atyo
Ab'omu nsi.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Yesu mumunoonya? Nedda
Ye-abanoonya mmwe;
Temweteekateeka,mujje
Nga bwe muli.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Omusango gwabasinga?
Abasonyiwa;
Abaggyako-abantu bonna
Ebyonoono

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
Ekisa kye mukigaanyi?
Temukkiriza?
Temumuganya kugenda
Nga-asaaliddwa.

verse.name: v7
verse.lines:
Oba-ennaku zammwe nnyingi?
Era mukooye?
Mumwanirize Mukama,
Muwummule.
